caption: Sunlight passes through a blue glass bottle on a windowsill, and a blue patch of light lies on the counter beside it.

sa.check: A glass bottle stands on a windowsill in sunlight.
A blue patch of light lies on the counter beside it.

pc.expect: The patch is on the side away from the sun and moves when the bottle is moved.
pc.fail: It lies on the sun side; or stays put while the bottle moves; or is there with no bottle.

pc.expect: The patch matches the bottle's blue.
pc.fail: It is white; or a different colour; or it changes colour with the bottle still.

pc.expect: The patch does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It drifts with the bottle still; or flickers in steady sun.

pc.expect: The patch is one soft shape roughly the bottle's footprint.
pc.fail: It splits; or is a sharp square; or floods the counter.
A second bottle appears; or the patch becomes solid; or the bottle vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sill and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The sill changes; or the counter changes colour; or the bottle changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
